method.timing: __ui.begin and actual submit click in the same page evaluation; end = save transaction oncomplete before resolving the Promise. Independent native event.timeStamp and later callback also recorded. No transport roundtrip before event. DOM frames are proxies, not phone touch-to-photon.
method.pairing: Fresh browser process/profile per invocation. Alternating before-after / after-before pairs. Serial execution; PWA initialized and draft durable outside save timing; all measured writes offline.
method.statistics: Standard median, p95 nearest rank. 8 correlated writes/profile; three independent processes. Cloud CPU throttle is not Android emulation.
method.preservation: Within-profile before/after history/archive SHA proofs; generated IDs/timestamps may differ between profiles.
